scripts.install:all: bun install && (cd apps/web && bun install) && (cd apps/mobile && bun install) && (cd apps/quasar && bun install) && (cd apps/website-app && bun install)
scripts.check: bun run check:topology && bun run check:web && bun run check:mobile && bun run check:quasar && bun run check:website-app
scripts.check:web: cd apps/web && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.check:mobile: cd apps/mobile && bun run typecheck && bun run test -- --runInBand && bun run lint && bunx expo export --platform web
scripts.check:quasar: cd apps/quasar && bun run typecheck && bun run test && (cd apps/quasar && bunx expo export --platform web)
scripts.check:website-app: cd apps/website-app && bun run db:migrate && bun run check
